Estimate tile by the box

Enter a simple surface area or the result of your sketch, coverage per box from the package, and your chosen allowance.

Planning result—

Enter dimensions and calculate. Values stay in your browser.

Method & sources

Order area = surface area × (1 + allowance ÷ 100). Boxes = round up order area ÷ coverage per box.

This formula does not simulate layout direction, grout joints, edge cuts or package differences. Check the result against a sketch and your supplier.
